content.text: I have reviewed all fee, payment, termination, and liability provisions. No redline is needed.

input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee on Corio (our side, as licensee and payer). Section 4 (Fees), Exhibit B (Pricing/Revenue Sharing) and Exhibit B Payment Terms create only ordinary fees for licenses, maintenance/support, MarketSite.net access, implementation on a capped time-and-materials basis, and a revenue share — none framed as liquidated damages or a penalty, and there is no late-payment penalty or interest charge. Section 11 permits non-renewal on 30 days' notice and termination for uncured material breach or insolvency with no termination fee or accelerated remaining-contract-value payment; Section 11.3 only continues fees for services Corio elects to keep receiving post-termination (survival of support in exchange for continued annual support payments), which is a fee-for-value term rather than a liquidated amount. The only refund/remedy mechanics (Sections 3, 7, 8) run in Corio's favour. Section 9 caps each party's liability at amounts actually paid by Corio and waives consequential damages, reinforcing the absence of any fixed damages formula against us. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is proposed.
